tickets.title: Prepare concise destination note for Raina Bramblequill
tickets.text: Prepare a concise destination note for Raina Bramblequill outlining operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and the CPA and attorney questions, referencing the $2,765,000 deposit at Teacup Comet Bank and the $1.74 million Velvet Acorn Custody balances.
tickets.evidence: Raina asked for a concise destination note covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions; the agreed follow-up is due January 10, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain escrow agreement and working‑capital schedule
tickets.text: Obtain the executed escrow agreement and the final working‑capital schedule for Raina Bramblequill’s sale of Cloudberry Kite Design Studio, which are missing from the sale file.
tickets.evidence: The agreed January 3, 2025 follow-up is to obtain the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule missing from the sale file.
